usedFor: Grist holds records in spreadsheet tables, and HubSpot receives their changes through “Update Deal” and other update actions.

bestTemplate.name: “Updated Record” in Grist, then “Update Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Editing a row in Grist can push the new values into the matching deal.

watchOut: “Update Deal” in HubSpot needs the deal ID, and “Updated Record” fires on every edit, so runs can repeat.
